name: Marital Love
overview: Scripture presents marital love as a sacred union where a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife, becoming one flesh, highlighting the deep, inseparable bond intended by God (Genesis 2:24). Joy and blessing are found in rejoicing with the spouse of one's youth, emphasizing faithfulness and delight within marriage (Proverbs 5:18). The Apostle Paul instructs wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, while husbands are called to love their wives as themselves, with wives showing reverence in return, outlining a Christ-centered pattern of mutual respect and sacrificial love (Ephesians 5:22, 33).
